blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Talisay City is known for its famous lechon, but this city in Metro Cebu has much more to offer its visitors. Macario Carl Cabusas II, president of the Talisay City Chamber of Commerce and Industry Inc., said the city also has local delicacies and resorts that could help attract more visitors. A Talisay native himself, Cabusas recalled having consilva (a caramelized banana brittle dessert) and linusak (mashed pounded banana dessert) as snacks when he was younger.
